aboutText: For nearly 30 years, Jesiel has guided leaders, business owners and families through decisions, relationships and life transitions. A Brazilian based in England, he brings international and intercultural experience to a personal, thoughtful mentoring relationship.
aboutText2: His work centres on listening, understanding people and helping them consider what comes next with greater clarity and purpose.
pastor: Jesiel also serves as a pastor. Vellora Connect offers professional mentoring independently of any church.
values: Perspective built over nearly three decades.
faqs: No. This is mentoring: a space to reflect on leadership, decisions and life transitions. Where specialist support is needed, we encourage you to work with a qualified professional.
Confidentiality is central to the mentoring relationship. Its scope and any legal or safeguarding exceptions are agreed before we begin.
How does the first conversation work?
It is a free, 30-minute conversation to understand what brings you here, answer your questions and explore the right next step. There is no obligation to continue.
Yes. Sessions are available online, with in-person formats in London arranged by agreement.
